title: Jev-as-a-Judge for Brazilian Portuguese Information Retrieval: Relevance Assessment and Reranking
abstract: arXiv:2610.23346v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This study investigates Jev, a System One model designed for fast, structured decision-making, in information retrieval. We use Jev-as-a-judge to generate relevance judgments for four Brazilian Portuguese IR collections covering different domains and compare them with the official relevance judgments of each collection. We also evaluate Jev as a reranker. For relevance assessment, exact agreement ranged from 52.9% to 64.9%, while quadratic weighted Cohen's kappa ranged from 0.52 to 0.82. Most disagreements involved adjacent relevance levels, with at least 94.5% of annotations matching exactly or differing by only one relevance level. Despite differences at the individual query--document level, Jev-generated qrels produced similar retrieval system rankings, with Kendall's tau ranging from 0.90 to 0.93 for NormasTCU and Ulysses-RFCorpus across the two evaluation metrics. translated_title: Jev作为评判者应用于巴西葡萄牙语信息检索：相关性评估与重排序
translated_abstract: 本研究探讨了Jev——一个为快速、结构化决策而设计的System One（第一系统）模型——在信息检索中的应用。我们采用Jev-as-a-judge（Jev作为评判者）的方式，为四个涵盖不同领域的巴西葡萄牙语信息检索文档集合生成相关性判断，并将其与各集合的官方相关性判断进行比较。我们还将Jev作为重排序器进行了评估。在相关性评估方面，完全一致率介于52.9%至64.9%之间，二次加权Cohen's kappa介于0.52至0.82之间。大多数分歧都涉及相邻的相关性等级，至少94.5%的标注完全匹配或仅相差一个相关性等级。尽管在单个查询—文档层面存在差异，但Jev生成的qrels（相关性判断集合）产生了与官方标注相似的检索系统排名：对于NormasTCU和Ulysses-RFCorpus两个数据集，在两种评估指标下Kendall's tau（肯德尔等级相关系数）介于0.90至0.93之间。在重排序任务中，Jev对每个查询的BM25检索出的前1000个候选文档进行了重新排序（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究证明，作为快速结构化决策模型的Jev充当“评判者”时，虽然在单个文档层面的相关性判断与人工标注存在一定差异，但其生成的相关性判断能产生与官方标注高度一致（Kendall's tau达0.90–0.93）的检索系统排名，并能有效充当重排序器，适用于巴西葡萄牙语信息检索。
en_tdlr: Using Jev, a System One fast-decision-making model, as a judge for Brazilian Portuguese IR produces relevance judgments that, despite moderate per-document agreement, yield retrieval system rankings highly consistent with official annotations (Kendall's tau 0.90–0.93) and serve as an effective reranker.
